---
title: "Forms"
---

These are the **sign-and-submit forms** for the RIPLRT Institute. Unlike the working templates in `/templates`, forms are meant to be completed, signed (typed name + date is fine), and returned to the PI or a designated lead, then stored in the member's record.

| Form | Submit when | File |
|---|---|---|
| Manual Acknowledgment Form | Within first 7 days; re-acknowledge at each annual review | `manual-acknowledgment.md` |
| Onboarding Checklist | Completed across the first 30 days | `onboarding-checklist.md` |
| Offboarding Checklist | Completed in the final 2 weeks | `offboarding-checklist.md` |

**Member affiliation (complete at intake):**

- Home institution: ☐ Lynn University ☐ University of Puerto Rico ☐ Other: ________ ☐ Independent
- Level: ☐ Undergraduate ☐ Graduate ☐ Postdoc / early-career ☐ Other: ________
- Operating umbrella: ☐ EBDL (Lynn) ☐ RIPLRT-direct
- IRB of record: ____________________   CITI completion date: ____________

*This determines your IRB path, data-access rights, and byline affiliation (@sec-entity-structure, @sec-data-governance).*

::: {.callout-note}
## Placeholder: where forms are stored
The exact submission destination (a private Google Drive / OneDrive folder, a REDCap form, or a signed PDF in the member's file) is confirmed during onboarding. Keep completed forms — which contain names and signatures — **out of any public version** of this manual or its repository.
:::

These forms intentionally mirror the working checklists in `/templates` (the Onboarding and Offboarding templates) so members can use the template to *do the work* and the form to *record completion*.
